difficulty_reason: The authors convert multiplicative gaps to additive gaps using an OR of pairwise-independent sampled bits, then quantify the gap via first and second moments. Combined with a uniform low-depth exact counting construction, this gives a nonroutine improvement of approximate counting depth.
